name: Ryuzaburo
source:
"You can always count on me!"

Type: Water Dragon
A type of creature that has been considered a sacred existence from ancient times. They manipulate water and weather.

Favorites: Sweets

One of the four who appeared in front of you when mononokes attacked the castle. He is a peacemaker and like a big brother to everyone.
He takes good care of you and is trustworthy. He might be a little too grown-up for you and hard to approach, but there may be sides of him that you still don't know...?

[From in-game profile]
